problems: No printed total/summary row found on any of pages 25-30 for Schedule A.

The "Number of Bedrooms/Bathrooms - Amenities" column uses codes like "1/1.5", "1/1.5/C", "2/2/T" that combine bed/bath counts with amenity letters (C/T/B per Key); left beds/baths empty per instructions since combined codes are ambiguous, codes preserved implicitly via unit list only (not individually noted per row to avoid excessive repetition) — exceptions: 6A-6W rows where code was clearly "0/1/T", "1/2", "2/3" format, interpreted as beds/baths.
Units RT1-RT32 have no bedroom/bath/type designation in the table; classified as type O (other) since not clearly storage, parking, or residential.

"Appurtenant Square Footage" column placed in ext_sf per instructions (terrace/balcony/cellar area per Key), though it is labeled generically "Appurtenant Square Footage" rather than one of the named categories.

carry_m taken as "Projected Montly Carrying Charges Assuming Real Estate Tax Benefits" column, consistent with tax_m/tax_a also being the tax-benefit scenario; the no-benefit carrying charge column value is not separately captured per the fixed schema.
